_source: Core Rulebook, Sorcerer: Bloodlines (legacy.aonprd.com/coreRulebook/classes/sorcerer.html, raw HTML read 2026-10-05; cross-checked against d20pfsrd's bloodline pages). The bloodline's class skill, bonus spells, bonus feats and arcana are the catalogue's (content/class-options/sorcerer-bloodlines.json); this file is what the powers DO.
_grammar: rules/class_abilities.py, module docstring. `power` is the key of a power in content/bloodlines/powers.json; a character has the ability exactly when rules/grantedpowers.py lists that power as had (the choice made, the level reached), and spends the pool that file defines. `$energy` and the other variant fields are filled from the variant picked with the choice.

abilities.name: Breath Weapon
abilities.source: draconic bloodline (d20pfsrd, read 2026-10-05): "This breath weapon deals 1d6 points of damage of your energy type per sorcerer level. Those caught in the area of the breath receive a Reflex save for half damage. The DC of this save is equal to 10 + 1/2 your sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier. The shape of the breath weapon depends on your dragon type" — the catalogue's `breath`, a 30-foot cone or a 60-foot line. Once a day; twice at 17th, three times at 20th.
abilities.text: Your dragon's $breath of $energy: 1d6 per level, Reflex half.

abilities.name: Elemental Blast
abilities.source: elemental bloodline (CRB, as content/bloodlines/powers.json gives it): a 20-foot-radius burst at range 60 ft, 1d6 points of damage of your energy type per sorcerer level, Reflex half (DC 10 + 1/2 sorcerer level + Cha); creatures that fail their save gain vulnerability to your energy type for a round. Once a day; twice at 17th, three times at 20th.
abilities.text: A 20-ft burst of $energy within 60 ft: 1d6 per level, Reflex half; a failed save leaves it vulnerable to $energy.
abilities.tell: A blast of raw $energy bursts around {target}.

abilities.name: Hellfire
abilities.source: infernal bloodline (CRB, as content/bloodlines/powers.json gives it): a 10-foot-radius burst at range 60 ft, 1d6 fire per sorcerer level, Reflex half (DC 10 + 1/2 sorcerer level + Cha); good creatures that fail are shaken for your level in rounds. Once a day; twice at 17th, three times at 20th.
abilities.text: A 10-ft burst of hellfire within 60 ft: 1d6 fire per level, Reflex half.
not_yet: The shaken rider on a good creature that fails: alignment is not tracked (owner ruling 2026-10-05), and shaking everyone would be a rule the book does not write.
